{{Recipe summary | Category = Recipes for dessert | Difficulty = 1 }} {{recipe|Brownies, Kahlua}} The original contributor left the following anecdote about this recipe:
"I accidentally spilled some coffee liqueur on a brownie I was about to eat, and when I tried it is was heavenly. That is how I came up with this dish."
[[Category:Recipes using chocolate]] __NOTOC__ == Ingredients == * 4 brownie squares, 6 x 6 x 1¼ inches * ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Coffee Liqueur|coffee liqueur]] * Warm [[Cookbook:Hot Fudge|hot fudge]] topping, poured into a squirt bottle * 4 scoops [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]] * Mixed nut topping (optional) * [[Cookbook:Mint|Mint]] sprigs, for garnish * Sweetened [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] == Procedure == #Place 1 square on a microwave-safe plate, and [[Cookbook:Microwave Cooking|microwave]] on high 20 seconds or until desired warmth. Repeat with next 4 squares. #Slowly bring liqueur to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a pan over low heat. Drizzle evenly over brownie squares. #Place a scoop of ice cream on each square and top with a good amount of whipped cream. Drizzle the whole thing with hot fudge and sprinkle with nut topping, if using. #Garnish with mint sprigs, if desired. Serve immediately. == Notes, tips, and variations == * Walnut brownies work very well in this dish. == Warnings == * Don't try to speed up the liqueur by raising the heat. If you're working on an open-flame stovetop, that could result in fire. {{DEFAULTSORT:Brownies, Kahlua}} [[Category:Recipes for brownies]] [[Category:Baking recipes]] [[Category:Recipes using ice cream]] [[Category:Recipes for dessert]] [[Category:Recipes for bars]] [[Category:Recipes using coffee liqueur]] [[Category:Recipes using whipped cream]] [[Category:Recipes using mint]]
